scripts.build:agent: cd agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-$(go env GOOS)-$(go env GOARCH) ./cmd/agent
scripts.build:agent:all: cd agent && mkdir -p ../data/agent-binaries && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-darwin-amd64 ./cmd/agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-darwin-arm64 ./cmd/agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-linux-amd64 ./cmd/agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-linux-arm64 ./cmd/agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-windows-amd64.exe ./cmd/agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../data/agent-binaries/itcake-agent-windows-arm64.exe ./cmd/agent
